prompt: A straight-on photo of a paint shop's quality-control bench with THREE rectangular colour sample cards stacked one above another. Top card: swatch solid BLUE, sticky note THE NAME BELOW THE SWATCH AGREES WITH THE COLOUR, red stamp under it SUPERVISOR: THE NOTE IS CORRECT. Middle card: swatch solid GREEN, sticky note THE NAME BELOW THE SWATCH AGREES WITH THE COLOUR, red stamp under it SUPERVISOR: THE NOTE IS MISTAKEN. Bottom card: swatch solid BLUE, sticky note THE NAME BELOW THE SWATCH DOES NOT MATCH THE COLOUR, red stamp under it SUPERVISOR: THE NOTE IS CORRECT. On every card a white strip directly under the swatch carries that card's name in large black capitals. Every colour card in this shop carries one of only two names: HARBOUR BLUE or MEADOW GREEN. The supervisor's red stamp is never wrong. Print each card's name in large capitals and keep every swatch colour, note and stamp exactly as described. Along the very bottom print the small caption PAINT SHOP QUALITY CONTROL. No other text anywhere.
easy_question: This image was supposed to show at least one colour sample card -- a block of solid paint colour with a printed name near it -- plus a yellow note and an ink stamp somewhere in the picture. Never mind how well it is drawn, or what any of the words say. Does the image actually DEPICT that subject? Answer NO only if it is blank or shows something completely different. Answer yes or no only.

reference.q_verbatim: Write out every line of printed, written or stamped text you can see IN THIS PICTURE -- including text on stickers, sticky notes, ink stamps, labels and cards. Copy each line exactly as it appears, character by character. Do NOT correct spelling, arithmetic or anything that looks wrong, and do not leave any line out. If there is no text at all, answer NONE. Separate the lines with spaces.
